goal: A Jev response body is exactly {"confidence": 1e400}. What does decode_json(body) do: return a value (give the value of "confidence" in the result) or raise a Failure (give its code)? Python 3 json semantics apply.

code.title: scripts/jev_decide.py excerpt (decode_json)

json.title: Python json note
json.text: json.loads calls parse_constant only for the literals -Infinity, Infinity and NaN. A numeric literal is parsed by float(), and float("1e400") is inf.
